title: Gon Sacrifices His Own Hands to Defeat the Bomber
youtube_tags: hunter x hunter greed island arc

cuts.voiceover_text: Deep in a forest on Greed Island, Genthru, the tall man in the white coat and glasses known as the Bomber, makes Gon, the spiky-haired boy in green, a promise: he will blow off his limbs one at a time until none are left. Gon answers by charging straight in. Genthru catches both of his forearms and detonates them point-blank, and through the flash the boy slams a kick into him that leaves the Bomber bleeding from the nose, stunned.

As the smoke clears, the Bomber pieces it together: the boy sacrificed his hands on purpose, guarding his right arm with thirty percent of his aura and driving the other seventy into his legs for that one kick. Gon rises, scorched and grinning through bruised cheeks, and Genthru, sweating, admits no sane person would ever try it.

Later, with both fighters battered, Gon does the unthinkable: he opens his card binder, says he gives up, and tells Genthru to take whatever he wants, asking only to keep one card. It is bait. The Bomber lunges in and crushes the boy's windpipe so he can never speak another card command, but Gon still blocks his follow-up strike, and Genthru roars his name in fury.

Then the trap springs. The card Genthru grabbed was a decoy: the real one reverts into a canister, and gasoline splashes across his coat and face. Soaked in fuel, he cannot risk his own explosions anymore, and Gon declares that he is taking him down.

His explosions sealed, Genthru plays his last card, a bomb he can plant with a single touch, and dives in to finish it. Gon stands his ground, fist already blazing with a huge sphere of aura, his own preparations complete. But instead of striking the Bomber, he smashes the punch straight through the forest floor, the ground caves in, and both of them plummet into a deep pit.

At the bottom, Genthru spots Gon watching from a side tunnel, then looks up. A card flutters down through the light and reverts into a massive boulder, dropping straight toward him with nowhere left to run.
